QuestInfo.0: You feel a little stronger, but you still have a long way to go. Talk to #b#p1032001##k for your second training session.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032001# says to continue hunting monsters. This time, you have to hunt #r20 #o0210100#s#k. 20 #o0210100#s! You feel a little nervous but you can't stop now!\n\n#o0210100# #r#a21331##k

0.0: 전보다 실력이 늘었군... 자네는 모르겠지만 이 하인즈의 눈에는 향상된 것이 보인다네. 하지만 아직 미숙한 부분이 많으니, 이 하인즈가 조금 더 도움을 주도록 하지. 어떤가? 수련을 받겠는가?

yes.0: 그럼 슬라임 20마리를 퇴치해 보게. 중요한 것은 기초 수련이지... 자네는 이미 8마리를 퇴치한 경험이 있으니 그리 어렵지 않을 걸세.

no.0: 스스로 수련할 수 있다면 그것도 좋을 테지...

0.0: You have improved a lot. You wouldn't notice it but I can see it. Still, you are not good enough. I will help you out little bit more. What do you think? Do you want to be trained a bit more?

yes.0: Then, eliminate #r20 #o0210100#s#k. What is important is basic training. You have already eliminated 8 of them before so it shouldn't be hard this time.

no.0: It's good if you can train by yourself.

1.0: Did you clear out 20 #o0210100#s? Oh, good. You made it. Wonderful. Keep your pace and you'll get better soon.

yes.0: You can't be a good Magician if you're satisfied with this. Until we meet again...keep training hard!
